notes: app 1.8.22: roll the stable channel to the latest published Suite 366 release (app + sandbox-api + sandbox-runner image pins bumped 1.8.10 -> 1.8.22; chart unchanged at 0.8.0). app_version drives the app/sandbox image pins in values.yaml (the appliance pins them for offline safety, update.sh rewrites the pins on apply). Bump chart_version / app_version / vllm_image here to roll out to the fleet; appliances poll this file daily and notify (no auto-apply). updater_sha256 and backup_sha256 are filled in by tools/sign-channel.sh - never by hand; they are what let an appliance trust the update.sh and backup.sh it fetches. backup_sha256 must be present: an appliance holding the package key REFUSES to refresh backup.sh without it, and a box whose updater rolls forward while its backup agent does not is a box that silently stops being backed up.
